atoms.b: Last summer, my family and I stayed on ((an)) incredible island for ((a)) week. We rented ((a)) cosy little cottage near the coast. Each morning, I went on ((a)) walk along the beach. One day, we took ((an)) adventurous hike through ((a)) forest and encountered ((a)) cute squirrel. During lunchtime, we often went to ((a)) restaurant which was about ((a)) kilometre away from the cottage. ((A)) relative on my father's side works there as ((a)) cook. In the evenings, my sister and I enjoyed the breathtaking sunset. It was truly ((an)) incredible holiday and I hope we'll be going back there again one day.
